# Tech Medics Macon

> Expert iPhone, iPad, MacBook, and game console repair in Macon, Georgia. Same-day service, 30-minute turnaround, walk-ins welcome. Locally owned since 2024.

## Business Information

- **Business Name:** Tech Medics Macon
- **Business Type:** Local electronics repair shop (Apple device specialist)
- **Address:** 3742 Eisenhower Parkway, Macon, GA 31206
- **Phone:** (478) 259-6371
- **Email:** Support@MyTechMedics.com
- **Website:** https://techmedicsmacon.com
- **Google Maps:** https://www.google.com/maps/place/3742+Eisenhower+Pkwy,+Macon,+GA+31206
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/TechMedicsMacon
- **Rating:** 4.9/5.0 (100+ verified reviews)
- **Price Range:** $$
- **Payment:** Cash, Credit Card, Debit Card

## Hours of Operation

- **Monday–Friday:** 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- **Saturday:** 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- **Sunday:** Closed

## Service Area

- **Primary:** Macon, GA (Bibb County)
- **Also Serving:** Warner Robins, Byron, Perry, Forsyth, Houston County, Peach County, Monroe County
- **Neighborhoods:** Vineville, North Macon, Downtown Macon, Ingleside, East Macon, South Macon, Bloomfield, Rutland

## Core Repair Services

### iPhone Repair
- Screen repair (all models iPhone 5s through iPhone 16 Pro Max, including iPhone 16e, SE 1st/2nd/3rd gen)
- Battery replacement
- Charging port repair
- Back glass repair
- Camera repair
- Speaker repair
- Water damage diagnostic and recovery

### iPad Repair
- Screen and digitizer replacement (all models: Pro M4, Air M2, Mini, standard)
- Battery replacement
- Charging port repair
- Camera repair
- Speaker repair
- Water damage diagnostic

### MacBook Repair
- Screen/Retina display replacement (Air M1–M4, Pro M1–M4, Intel models)
- Battery replacement
- Keyboard and trackpad repair
- Charging port repair
- Logic board diagnostics and repair
- Data recovery
- Water damage diagnostic

### Game Console Repair
- PlayStation 5 / PS5 Slim (HDMI port, disc drive, fan/overheating)
- Xbox Series X / Series S (HDMI port, disc drive, controller, fan)
- Nintendo Switch / Switch OLED / Switch Lite (controller, fan, battery, screen)
- Steam Deck (controller, fan, battery, screen)

### Additional Services
- Data recovery from broken, water-damaged, or dead devices
- Business/fleet device repair with volume discounts
- On-site support for Macon-area businesses
- Accessories (screen protectors, cases)
- Educational institution device support

## Why Tech Medics vs. Other Macon Repair Shops

Tech Medics is Macon's only **Apple-specialist repair shop**. Unlike national franchise chains and big-box kiosks that fix every brand (Samsung, Motorola, LG, Google, etc.), Tech Medics focuses exclusively on **Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, MacBook) and game consoles**.

- **Apple-Only Specialists:** Deeper expertise from working on Apple hardware all day, every day
- **Micro-Soldering Capability:** Board-level repairs (water damage, logic board, HDMI ports) that generalist shops cannot perform
- **Independently Owned Since 2024:** Not a franchise — real accountability and community roots
- **4.9-Star Rating (100+ Reviews):** Highest customer rating among Macon phone repair shops

## Key Differentiators

- **30-Minute Service:** Most iPhone screen repairs completed in 30 minutes or less
- **Walk-Ins Welcome:** No appointment needed
- **30-Day Warranty:** Every repair backed by parts and labor warranty
- **No Fix, No Fee:** You only pay if the device is repaired
- **Same-Day Service:** Most repairs completed the same day
- **Price Match Guarantee:** Will match any local competitor's pricing
- **30–50% Below Apple Store Rates:** Competitive pricing on all repairs
- **Independently Owned & Operated:** Not a franchise — serving Macon since 2024
